TabMerger (v3.15.0) is an open-source browser extension available for Chrome, Firefox, and Edge designed to help manage browser memory usage by consolidating multiple tabs into a single, color-coded internal list.

The tool allows users to group tabs and retain them across browser sessions, aiming to reduce overall RAM footprint on Windows, Linux, and macOS.
